text: Exploiting Blockchain Data to Detect Smart Ponzi Schemes on Ethereum presents the following source proposition: First, 200 smart Ponzi schemes are obtained by manually checking more than 3,000 open source smart contracts on the Ethereum platform. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Because Ethereum's decentralized platform incorporating smart contracts lets developers build applications directly on its blockchain, the majority of developers chose to write smart contracts on the Ethereum Virtual Machine rather than create their own blockchain technology, giving ICOs a uniform protocol.
